sources.title: Charles H. Bennett, Ethan Bernstein, Gilles Brassard, and Umesh Vazirani, Strengths and Weaknesses of Quantum Computing (arXiv:quant-ph/9701001)

sources.title: Ben W. Reichardt, Span Programs and Quantum Query Complexity: The General Adversary Bound Is Nearly Tight for Every Boolean Function (arXiv:0904.2759)
sources.locator: Complete 70-page PDF and extracted text retrieved; selected text read: §2.2, Theorem 6.1/6.2 statements and proof portions, Theorem 8.5 with its zero-eigenvalue proof, Theorem 10.1, and §11. Not claimed as a full-document or complete-theorem-proof read. Theorem 10.1 has a logarithmic overhead; §11 records removal as a conjecture.

sources.title: Troy Lee, Rajat Mittal, Ben W. Reichardt, Robert Špalek, and Mario Szegedy, Quantum Query Complexity of State Conversion (arXiv:1011.3020)
sources.locator: Complete 19-page PDF and extracted text retrieved; relevant proof sections read: §§2.2–4.2 and Appendix A, including Theorem 1.1, filtered-γ₂ comparison, Theorems 4.1–4.3, effective spectral-gap proof and phase-detection query cost. Not claimed as a full-document read.

sources.title: Yohichi Suzuki, Shumpei Uno, Rudy Raymond, Tomoki Tanaka, Tamiya Onodera, and Naoki Yamamoto, Amplitude Estimation without Phase Estimation (arXiv:1904.10246)
sources.locator: Complete 13-page PDF/text retrieved; selected Sections 1–3.2 read. The likelihood procedure and asymptotic Fisher-information analysis were inspected; no finite-sample tail guarantee is claimed.
